title: Content change proposal, version 1
description: The document of a CONTENT_CHANGE_PROPOSAL statement: the artist of a 1/1 work proposes new display content. Display only; the token's media and tokenURI never change. Rules: docs/spec/declarations-and-conventions.md (DCL-10 to DCL-15).

subject.description: The 6529 Stream token; equal to the statement's (token, id) and the log's chain.

fromContentHash.description: The work's approved content hash (media[0].sha256Hash), so the proposal names the work it changes.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the decoded proposed primary file.

fileId.description: A content-store file ID holding the proposed file, if it is stored there.

withdrawn.description: True withdraws the proposal this entry supersedes (the statement's supersedes field); content then repeats it.

expiresAt.description: No acceptance recorded after this time counts.
